risks.risk: Wrong console model (Series X vs One X vs Series S) which changes value significantly; photos don’t show the model label.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console rear/underside model label/serial (or Settings > System > Console info showing model).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-likely Xbox model among common options (worst-case for value) until model is confirmed.

risks.risk: Game list/count may be different from what’s claimed (only EA FC 25 is clearly shown).
risks.proof: A photo/screenshot of the 'My games & apps' library showing all installed games (and storage sizes) or a video scrolling through the list.
risks.if_unproven: Price as fewer/unknown games installed (worst-case: only the clearly shown game).

risks.risk: Controller authenticity/condition (the controller shown may be a custom skin/cover; could be non-original or worn).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the controller model/label on the back and a screenshot showing controller firmware/connection, plus photo of ports/charging.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming controller is not guaranteed original and may need replacement (worst-case: treat as generic/uncertain).

risks.risk: Port/connection issues not visible (HDMI/USB/network could fail under use).
risks.proof: Video test showing HDMI output, at least two USB devices, and network sign-in/online game launch.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed (worst-case: assume possible port faults until tested).

risks.risk: Thermal/overheating not proven (could fail after longer sessions).
risks.proof: A short video of a 30–60 minute gameplay session without shutdown plus a photo of any fan/noise behavior (or console error-free run).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential overheating risk (worst-case: treat as could overheat).

risks.risk: Receipt/warranty claim may be false or missing.
risks.proof: Photo of the UK receipt (with sensitive details blurred) and any warranty/serial match to the console label.
risks.if_unproven: Price without receipt/warranty benefit (worst-case: no proof of purchase).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console model label/serial (rear or underside) and/or Settings > System > Console info showing model.
Screenshot/photo of 'My games & apps' showing the full installed games list (confirm the exact 6 and their names).
Photo of the controller back label/model and a quick video showing it connects and works (button test).
Video test of all ports: HDMI + USB + network sign-in (and ideally an online launch).
A longer run video (30–60 minutes) to confirm no overheating/shutdown.
response.reason: The photos confirm an Xbox console is running EA FC 25, but the key pricing drivers (exact console model and full installed game list/count) are not verifiable from the images. Without those, any price would be guesswork.
